description: This file implements the Pause task for a web audio player, including constructor, destructor, and execute method to change the player's pipeline state to paused.

classes.name: Pause
classes.description: Represents a task to pause the web audio player, managing state change and logging.

methods.name: Pause
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Pause task with references to the player and client.

methods.name: ~Pause
methods.description: Destructor that logs the completion of the Pause task.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the action of pausing the web audio player by changing its pipeline state.
